verses.text: A psalm for reflection by Asaph. God, why have you pushed us away for good? Why is your anger still smoldering against the sheep of your own pasture?
Remember the people you bought long ago, the tribe you rescued to be your own. Remember Mount Zion, where you made your home.
Come walk through these ruins that never seem to end. Look at all the damage the enemy did in your sanctuary.
Your enemies roared right in the middle of your gathering place. They put up their own banners as signs.
They went at it like people swinging axes through a thicket.
They smashed all the carved woodwork with hatchets and hammers.
They burned your sanctuary to the ground. They defiled the place where your name dwells.
They said to themselves, “We’ll crush them completely.” They burned every place in the land where people worshiped God.
We don’t see any miraculous signs. There’s no prophet left, and nobody here knows how long this will last.
How long will the enemy mock you, God? Will they drag your name through the dirt forever?
Why are you holding back your hand, your right hand? Pull it out from against your chest and finish them!
Yet you’ve been my King from long ago, God, bringing rescue all across the earth.
You split the sea by your strength. You smashed the heads of the sea monsters in the water.
You shattered Leviathan’s heads and gave him as food to people and creatures in the desert.
You opened up springs and streams. You dried up mighty rivers.
The day is yours, and so is the night. You put the light and the sun in place.
You set every boundary of the earth. You made summer and winter.
Remember how the enemy mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have insulted your name.
Don’t hand your dove over to wild beasts. Don’t forget the lives of your poor forever.
Honor your covenant. The dark places of the earth are full of hideouts where violence thrives.
Don’t send the oppressed away in shame. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
Rise up, God! Stand up for your own cause. Remember how fools mock you all day long.
Don’t forget the voices of your enemies. The roar of those who rise against you never lets up.
